summary.authority: development measurement only; recall only, no safety metric

retrieval_cost_definition.token_definition: whitespace tokens of item text shown at the scored depth; excludes other candidates, metadata and query/prompt wrappers
retrieval_cost_definition.text_fields: project-memory title + summary + body; embedding/search inputs are unchanged
retrieval_cost_definition.recall_definition: gold-event ID recall; no separate usefulness or critical-evidence weighting unless the runner declares it
retrieval_cost_definition.aggregation: ratio of means: 1000 * sum(per-query recall) / sum(per-query retrieved tokens)

summary.safety_caveat: PMLAB-REUSE-CHAR-001 measured dense forbidden intrusion at 0.200 against FTS5's 0.050. A superseded fact is maximally similar to its replacement. This run measures recall only and is not a licence to adopt dense retrieval.
